_comment: Tracks image assets that have a re-created candidate file sitting alongside the accepted production file. Nothing in data/questions_v1.json references a *_candidate.webp path -- these are review-only and never served to students until explicitly promoted (candidate file copied over the accepted one, coordinates updated in data/questions_v1.json). No entries are currently pending -- all S-rank replacements attempted this pass were promoted directly to accepted (see docs/v2.0.1_asset_source_log.md for the full record). This file is kept as the mechanism for any future re-creation work that wants a review-mode compare step before promotion.
